subject: Runtime integration launch logistics — schema and streaming pre-kickoff
body:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Sara Lim <sara@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Runtime integration launch logistics — schema and streaming pre-kickoff

Hi Ethan / Sara,

Summary: Helios is ready to move from trial to pilot next week. Before our kickoff, Monica is handing the implementation logistics to Ethan. This thread captures the immediate pre-kickoff asks so the kickoff can focus on sequencing and runbook items rather than discovery.

Key objectives for the kickoff (30–45m):
- Confirm streaming endpoints and expected RPS/latency SLOs for the pilot.
- Validate function/tool call surface area (external tool endpoints + auth).
- Lock the structured output JSON schema for 1.0 responses (fields, enums, error payloads).
- Agree on short-term prefix caching strategy and trace identifiers for debugging.

Pre-kickoff checklist (please confirm by EOD):
- Helios: provide sample payloads for 3 representative flows (already in Drive).
- Redwood (Ethan): quick perf baseline on requested model variant with sample Helios sequences.
- Security: share retention and encryption constraints (Sara indicated HIPAA adjacency).
- Procurement: DocuSign envelope for pilot contract (Procurement contact cc'd).

Attachments I uploaded: Helios_MAP_v1.pdf (mutual action plan), streaming_schema_v0.9.json (draft), redwood_runtime_config.yaml (recommended runtime flags).

Ethan — can you pick a 45m slot tomorrow for the kickoff and run the quick perf baseline before kickoff? Sara — any constraints on IP allowlists or specific egress patterns we should know about?

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

--

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sara Lim <sara@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime integration launch logistics — schema and streaming pre-kickoff

Thanks Monica — I can take this. Proposed kickoff windows (PST): Thu 2025-05-22 09:00-09:45, 11:00-11:45, or 14:00-14:45. I will reserve the 11:00 slot tentatively unless you prefer another.

Pre-kickoff actions I'll handle today:
- Run a perf baseline on the requested model with the short Helios sample (attached as streaming_schema_v0.9.json) and report token latency/95th percentiles.
- Outline a minimal JSON schema checklist (required fields, fallback fields, error envelope, versioning key) and post to the Drive link.
- Prepare a short demo of function/tool calling mapping (1 external tool: claims-lookup API) and a plan for secure credentials (short-lived service account + vault).

Questions for Helios before kickoff:
1) For streaming sessions, do you expect single-session multi-turn flows (user-driven) or many short single-turn requests? This affects KV cache sizing.
2) Do you require server-side callouts from Redwood to your APIs (we support proxied calls) or will you invoke tool endpoints directly from the client?

Sara — on retention: Monica noted HIPAA-adjacent. If Helios needs no transcript retention beyond 30 days, we can enable automatic TTL; if they require longer retention for audit, we will need to confirm storage encryption-at-rest & access logs.

I will upload the perf baseline report and schema checklist to the Drive folder and ping the kickoff invite when confirmed.

—Ethan
Ethan Park
Implementation Engineer | Redwood Inference
ethan_park@redwood.ai

--

From: Sara Lim <sara@helioshealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Helios Health Ops <ops@helioshealth.com>, procurement@helioshealth.com
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime integration launch logistics — schema and streaming pre-kickoff

Hi all,

Thanks — Thu 11:00 PST works for us. Quick clarifications so Ethan can scope perf runs:
- Streaming usage pattern: primarily short single-turn calls (~200–400 tokens); a small subset (5–8%) will be multi-turn conversations up to ~2,000 tokens.
- Tools: we expect two server-side callouts from Redwood during generation: (1) claims-lookup (internal API) and (2) EHR-query (tokenized patient id). Both must be invoked server-side; we cannot expose EHR endpoints to client browsers.
- Security: retention must be 90 days for pilot logs, encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys if possible. We can provide KMS details after the kickoff.

Also, procurement will complete the DocuSign today — procurement@helioshealth.com is on copy.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Sara
Sara Lim
Senior PM, Integrations | Helios Health
sara@helioshealth.com

--

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 15:38:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Runtime integration launch logistics — schema and streaming pre-kickoff

Hannah — forwarding the thread. Helios will require: server-side tool callouts to claims-lookup and EHR-query, 90-day retention with CMK, and a small percentage of long multi-turn sessions (~2k tokens).

Can you confirm the following before kickoff?
- Is CMK-backed storage for pilot logs available in our VPC option, and what is the timeline to enable for a new account?
- Any audit log formats we should provide to Helios to satisfy their QA team (syslog / JSON lines preferred)?
- Will we need a signed Addendum for HIPAA adjacency for pilot, or can an SLA + KMS be sufficient?

I will attach the perf baseline and schema checklist once the jobs finish (running now).

Thanks,
—Ethan
